column2: COMBO PAY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 連続ヒット(画面の「N HIT」)が10回に届くたびにMILE+1(1Lvごとに+1)。20回・30回…と続けるほど何度ももらえる(1回の連続ヒットで100HITまで)
column4: Each time your hit streak (the "N HIT" counter) reaches a multiple of 10, gain +1 MILE (+1 per Lv). Keeps paying at 20, 30 and so on (up to 100 HIT per streak)

column2: HUNT PAY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 雑魚を10体倒すたびにMILE+1(1Lvごとに+1)。ボスは数えない
column4: Gain +1 MILE (+1 per Lv) for every 10 enemies defeated. Bosses don't count

column2: BOSS PAY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: ボス撃破のMILE+12%/Lv

column2: ROAD PAY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 1km走るたびにMILE+2(1Lvごとに+2)。疾走出発やCONTINUEで飛ばした区間は数えない
column4: Gain +2 MILE (+2 per Lv) for every 1km you run. Sections skipped by Sprint Start or CONTINUE don't count

column2: SURVIVAL PAY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: ランで30秒生き残るたびにMILE+1(1Lvごとに+1)。カード選択・一時停止の間は数えない
column4: Gain +1 MILE (+1 per Lv) for every 30 seconds you survive in a run. Card choices and pauses don't count

column2: COMBO TRAINING の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 連続ヒットが10回に届くたびにEXP+20(1Lvごとに+20)。1回の連続ヒットで100HITまで
column4: Each time your hit streak reaches a multiple of 10, gain EXP +20 (+20 per Lv). Up to 100 HIT per streak

column3: 雑魚を10体倒すたびにEXP+30(1Lvごとに+30)。ボスは数えない
column4: Gain EXP +30 (+30 per Lv) for every 10 enemies defeated. Bosses don't count

column2: BOSS TRAINING の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: ボス撃破のEXP+15%/Lv

column2: ROAD TRAINING の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 1km走るたびにEXP+100(1Lvごとに+100)。疾走出発やCONTINUEで飛ばした区間は数えない
column4: Gain EXP +100 (+100 per Lv) for every 1km you run. Sections skipped by Sprint Start or CONTINUE don't count

column2: SURVIVAL TRAINING の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: ランで30秒生き残るたびにEXP+30(1Lvごとに+30)。カード選択・一時停止の間は数えない
column4: Gain EXP +30 (+30 per Lv) for every 30 seconds you survive in a run. Card choices and pauses don't count

column2: DANGER BOUNTY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 雑魚の一部が高火力敵(赤紫のオーラ。攻撃のダメージ+1ハート)になる(1Lvごとに+3%、最大30%。0kmから)。代わりに敵撃破・BONUSのMILE+15%/Lv、敵撃破EXP+10%/Lv。敵が変わるのはソロの通常マップだけ
column4: Some enemies become Heavy Hitters (magenta aura, +1 heart damage) (+3% per Lv, up to 30%, from 0km). In return: enemy/BONUS MILE +15% per Lv, enemy defeat EXP +10% per Lv. Enemies only change in solo runs on normal maps

column2: SKY SIEGE の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 空中の敵の枠に空中雑魚(急降下・横切りなど)が出やすくなり(+5%/Lv)、空の敵がいる組も出やすくなる(+10%/Lv)。代わりに敵撃破EXP+15%/Lv、敵撃破・BONUSのMILE+8%/Lv
column4: Air enemies (divers, crossers, etc.) fill air slots more often (+5% per Lv), and groups with flying enemies appear more often (+10% per Lv). In return: enemy defeat EXP +15% per Lv, enemy/BONUS MILE +8% per Lv

column2: CROSSROADS の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 道中の判断イベント(上下の帯・封鎖・高火力敵など)が早い距離から始まり(通常50km → 1Lvごとに4km早く、最短10km)、間隔も短くなる(-5%/Lv、最大-50%)。代わりに敵撃破・BONUSのMILE+12%/Lv、獲得EXP+8%/Lv。判断イベントはソロの通常マップだけ
column4: Road decision events (lane warnings, blockades, Heavy Hitters, etc.) start earlier (normally 50km; 4km earlier per Lv, 10km at the earliest) and come more often (gap -5% per Lv, up to -50%). In return: enemy/BONUS MILE +12% per Lv, EXP gained +8% per Lv. Decision events only happen in solo runs on normal maps

column2: HIGH STAKES の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: ボスから受けるダメージ+10%/Lv(ハート単位。端数は確率で1つ増える)。代わりにボス撃破MILE+35%/Lv、ボス撃破EXP+15%/Lv
column4: Damage taken from bosses +10% per Lv (in hearts; a fraction may add 1 more heart). In return: boss defeat MILE +35% per Lv, boss defeat EXP +15% per Lv

column2: CHAIN BOUNTY の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 連続ヒットが10HIT以上続いている間に倒した雑魚のMILEと撃破EXPが増える(+15%/Lv)。連続ヒットを切らさずに倒し続けるほど得
column4: Enemies defeated while your hit streak is at 10 HIT or more give more MILE and defeat EXP (+15% per Lv). Keep the streak going while you defeat enemies

column2: IRON MARATHON の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 被弾せずに1km走るたびにMILE+3とEXP+150(1Lvごとに増加)。被弾すると数え直し(Shieldで防いだ時はそのまま)
column4: Every 1km you run without taking damage gives +3 MILE and EXP +150 (more per Lv). Taking damage resets the count (blocking with a Shield doesn't)

column2: TROPHY HUNT の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: ボスを倒すと、前のボスから倒した雑魚1体につきMILE+0.2とEXP+3(1Lvごとに増加、最大100体分)。雑魚を倒してからボスへ挑むほど得
column4: Defeating a boss gives +0.2 MILE and EXP +3 for each enemy defeated since the previous boss (more per Lv, up to 100 enemies). Clear out enemies before you take on the boss

column2: HORIZON の説明(カード詳細・3択)
column3: 走行距離10kmごとに、敵撃破・ボス・BONUSのMILEと獲得EXPが+2%/Lvずつ増える(100kmで最大、Lv1で+20%)。遠くまで走るほど伸びる
column4: Every 10km you run, enemy/boss/BONUS MILE and EXP gained rise by +2% per Lv (max at 100km; +20% at Lv1). The farther you run, the more it grows
